name: 3topChat
description: Trilingual (ES/PT/EN) NLP optimisation study: one recommender, five interchangeable engines — a TF-IDF Naive Bayes trained on its own vocabulary against four local LLMs — scored on the same 140 golden cases. LangGraph, Chroma RAG, llama.cpp, grammar-constrained decoding, and a verifier that blocks any number the code did not compute.
